statement: "If this card on the field would be used as Synchro Material, 1 Tuner in your hand can be used as 1 of the other materials." isn't treated as an effect: while the card's effects are negated, a Tuner in the hand can still be one of its Synchro Materials.

sources.name: Kewl Tune Cue
sources.says: 「フィールドのこのカードを素材としてS召喚する場合、手札のチューナー１体もS素材にできる」は効果として扱いません。（効果が無効化されている状況でも、フィールドのこのカードを素材としてS召喚する場合、手札のチューナー１体もS素材にできます。） Konami's FAQ of cards 21953, 21954, 21955, 21957 and 22531 says the same of the same words (read by Claude, 2026-11-20, from db-ygoresources-com/yugioh-faq-history).

scripts: The scripts agree: Kewl Tune Track Maker's, Reco's and Cue's EFFECT_HAND_SYNCHRO have CANNOT_DISABLE and UNCOPYABLE.
